title: Tag contacts
blurb: Label people so you can filter, message and automate by group.

steps.title: Tag one person
steps.body: Open a contact by clicking their name. In the **Tags** section on the left, pick or type a tag and click **Apply**.

steps.title: Tag lots of people
steps.body: Back on the list, tick the boxes next to everyone you want to tag.

steps.title: Click Add Tag
steps.body: In the toolbar that appears, click the **Add Tag** icon.

steps.title: Pick the tags
steps.body: Give the job a name, choose one or more tags, and click **Add Tags**. Existing tags stay on.

steps.title: Check progress
steps.body: Big jobs run in the background. Track them under the **Bulk Actions** tab.
steps.tip: Tags can start workflows, for example tagging someone "booked" can send a confirmation text.
